source_snapshot.procedure: Verify UART from CPU to USB-C functional.
source_snapshot.criteria: UART is functioning normally and can send and receive traffic.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 20 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: PARTIAL; enumerates USB serial devices with insecure/malformed truncated SSH, leaving physical traffic to an operator.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION/MEDIUM; held Pending for CPU-UART/USB-C topology, stable tty, serial profile, safe peer/payload, two-way integrity criteria and recovery.

old_problem: Enumeration cannot prove the CPU UART route or bidirectional data. Wildcard tty selection can hit an unrelated privileged console, while the source omits physical peer, serial profile, bounded payload and error/timeout criteria.
disposition_reason: The engineering method is standard and safe when parameterized: bind the CPU UART through connector/adapter to a stable tty, exclude every console/control path, have an operator attach the approved isolated peer, and exchange a bounded framed payload in both directions with exact byte and error accounting. Missing port/settings/payload values are runtime Project Configuration, not unresolved command semantics.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2166, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2167 / Wistron-GB NV PVP HW-00054-V002 / f72a7bebf0289619 was directly read from XLSX and manifest.
Bind CPU UART controller/channel, USB-C connector, cable/adapter descriptors and stable tty topology; never select by tty number/wildcard order.
Prove the target is not an active kernel, BMC, debug, service or recovery console before opening it.
Operator confirms the cable and isolated loopback/peer; bind baud/data/parity/stop/flow settings and a bounded non-sensitive framed payload for each direction.
PASS requires byte-for-byte content/order/count, explicit timeouts and zero disallowed framing/parity/overrun/reset/disconnect deltas.
Use trusted access and complete logs; reject sshpass, host-key bypass, truncation, unknown-console traffic, unbounded echo loops and automatic retry.
No serial enumeration, port open, physical connection, traffic, reset, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.purpose: Prove the intended CPU UART is physically routed to USB-C and transmits and receives a bounded payload through the approved peer with exact integrity and no serial/console impact.
required_package: Console/debug/service ownership exclusion and trusted device access
Operator-supplied approved cable plus isolated loopback/peer
Signed baud/data/parity/stop/flow, payload/direction, timeout and error limits
Complete USB/serial/kernel logging, cleanup and recovery
test_case.test_command: BLOCKED until Project Configuration is signed. Operator confirms the physical path and isolated peer. Collect stable USB/tty identity and full baseline logs, open only the approved non-console tty with the signed profile, exchange the bounded framed payload in both directions, compare bytes/order/count/timeouts/error counters, then close and restore the original state.
test_case.expected_result: The topology-bound path remains enumerated and both directions deliver the exact approved payload with zero disallowed framing, parity, overrun, timeout, reset, disconnect or console-impact events.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS requires physical/topology proof and complete two-way byte/error evidence. FAIL on wrong device/peer, any byte mismatch, one-way failure, limit breach, reset/disconnect or console impact. Missing mapping/profile/peer/criteria is runtime BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until stable topology, non-console ownership, serial contract, peer and recovery are signed.
Use bounded non-sensitive payloads; no credentials, escape/control sequences, wildcard tty or uncontrolled echo loop.
Stop on prompt/console interaction, wrong peer, reset/disconnect or serial errors; no automatic retry.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and CPU-UART/USB-C/adapter/tty topology
Operator connection photo and console-ownership exclusion
Full descriptors/driver/device identity and exact serial profile
Timestamped two-way transmit/receive frames plus byte/order/count and timeout/error comparison
Pre/post kernel/USB/serial evidence and restored closed state
test_case.recovery: Stop on wrong path, console impact or transport fault, preserve evidence and close the device without sending further data. Restore only the approved port/driver/service state and have the operator recover the cable/peer; do not reset or retry automatically.

source_conflict.reason: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently require functional bidirectional CPU UART traffic through USB-C.

blocked.reason: The end-to-end method, evidence and safety boundary are complete; target mapping, serial settings and peer are runtime project inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CPU-UART/USB-C/adapter/tty map, console exclusion, peer, serial profile, bounded payload, timeout/error limits, cleanup and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED; PARAMETERIZED UART TRAFFIC GATE CLOSED; NO ENUMERATION, PORT OPEN, PHYSICAL CONNECTION, TRAFFIC, RESET, RETRY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: Platform UART/USB owner, OS/console owner and lab operator
pending.unlock_condition: Bind the signed path/profile/peer/criteria and authorize operator setup plus bounded traffic; no new review decision is required absent routing change.

external_authorities.application: Requires end-to-end purpose-fit evidence, manual physical setup, signed criteria, secure access and no automatic retry.

project_authority: Platform owner binds the UART/USB-C path; OS owner excludes consoles and approves tty use; lab operator supplies the peer; engineer owns verdict.
